description: 智能概念抽取与核心概念识别增强 - 支持语言配置、概念详情（解释+示例）、核心概念识别、PDF页码跳转

userStories.title: 更新数据库 schema 存储概念详情
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to extend database schema to store concept descriptions, examples, core flags, and page numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add description column to concepts table (TEXT, nullable)
Add examples column to concepts table (JSON, nullable, stores array of examples)
Add is_core column to concepts table (BOOLEAN, default false)
Add page_number column to concepts table (INTEGER, nullable)
Add chunk_id column to concepts table (INTEGER, foreign key to chunks)
Create database migration file
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: description and examples already existed in nodes table; added is_core, page_number to nodes; added language to books table

userStories.title: 修改 chunk 切分策略（4K tokens + 全量）
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to increase chunk size to 4000 tokens and process entire book content without sampling.
acceptanceCriteria: Change chunk size configuration from current value to 4000 tokens
Remove sampling logic, ensure all book content is processed
Update chunk boundary handling for large chunks
Verify memory and performance with large chunks
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Changed chunk size from 1000 to 16000 characters (~4000 tokens), overlap from 100 to 400

userStories.title: 增强概念抽取 Prompt
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to update LLM extraction prompt to output concept descriptions, examples, and page numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Update prompt to require LLM output: name, description (2-3 sentences), examples (1-2 items), page_number
Include language instruction in prompt based on book configuration
Define JSON Schema for structured output validation
Handle malformed LLM responses gracefully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Enhanced system prompt with detailed requirements; added JSON Schema to user prompt; improved error handling with validation and graceful degradation

userStories.title: 实现核心概念识别算法
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to automatically identify the most important core concepts in a book.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement multi-dimensional scoring algorithm: frequency (appearance count), centrality (PageRank), importance (LLM score)
Sort by composite score and mark top N (e.g., top 20% or fixed 10) as core concepts
Set is_core = true for core concepts in database
Create API endpoint GET /api/books/{id}/core-concepts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented PageRank + frequency scoring with 50/50 weight. API endpoints: GET /api/books/{id}/core-concepts and POST /api/books/{id}/identify-core-concepts. GraphNode now includes is_core field.

userStories.title: 添加书籍语言配置选项
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select extraction language (Chinese or English) when importing a book.
acceptanceCriteria: Add language selection to book upload form (options: Auto, Chinese, English)
Store language in books table (lang: 'zh' | 'en' | 'auto')
Default to 'auto' for backward compatibility
Update book creation API to accept language parameter
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added language selection UI with two-step upload flow. Backend API updated to accept language parameter. Default 'auto' for backward compatibility.

userStories.title: 更新概念抽取流程集成
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to integrate new features into the existing extraction pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Update extraction flow to read book language config and pass to prompt
Update extraction to store description, examples, page_number from LLM output
Run core concept identification as separate step after extraction
Update progress indicators to include core concept identification phase
Maintain backward compatibility with existing books
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 更新概念图谱节点展示
userStories.description: As a user, I want core concepts to be visually distinct from regular concepts in the graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Core concept nodes use special visual marker (larger size or different color/border)
Add legend explaining core concept indicator
Maintain graph interaction smoothness
Update graph API to include is_core flag in node data
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 实现节点详情弹窗
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see detailed concept information when clicking a node.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking node opens detail panel/sidebar
Panel displays: concept name, description, examples
Panel includes 'View in PDF' button
Panel can be closed/dismissed
Responsive design for different screen sizes
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 实现 PDF 页面跳转定位
userStories.description: As a user, I want to jump directly to the PDF page where a concept appears.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'View in PDF' opens PDF reader
PDF automatically jumps to concept's page number
Support returning to concept graph from PDF view
Handle page numbers correctly for both PDF and EPUB
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 添加核心概念列表视图
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated view listing all core concepts of a book.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Core Concepts' tab/link in book detail page
List displays core concept name, brief description, page number
List items clickable to view concept details
Support direct PDF jump from list items
Handle empty state (when no concepts extracted)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
